targets.title: Socially evaluated cold pressor stress after instrumental learning favors habits over goal-directed action.
targets.evidence_quote: In the current study, we conducted a conceptual replication of the study by Schwabe and Wolf (2010).
targets.outcome_quote: We did not replicate the pattern of findings by Schwabe and Wolf (2010).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall nonreplication verdict; stress participants were sensitive to outcome devaluation using taste aversion.

reasoning: Exact title and four authors verified in complete accepted manuscript. One new-sample conceptual replication. Eder and Dignath supplied the alternative devaluation method and motivation, not the target stress finding. Other Schwabe papers are background or earlier related studies, not additional targets.
